svg.title: Thai Nguyen · Senior Product Owner, fintech
svg.desc: I build payments, identity and credit products, and I check the numbers myself. Senior Product Owner at Zalopay; previously Lazada. Open to product roles in Singapore.
svg.text: THAI NGUYEN · HO CHI MINH CITY
Senior Product Owner at Zalopay, lead of the User Core
team: eKYC, login and account security. Also payments
and Buy Now Pay Later. Before that, Lazada.
